findings.title: DateSearch result change leaves three existing regression expectations stale
findings.releaseBlockingReason: Existing targeted regression command exits one; required validation is not green. This is a test-gate defect, not evidence of wrong recovered entropy.
findings.expected: Supported DateMatch results and their exact regression expectations agree, with complete decoding dates and independently checked public phrase/counts.
findings.observed: 16/19 tests pass. Three deep equality assertions fail because results include allDates; the no-wallet result also has its evidence property set to undefined. Current typecheck passes. allDates is an intentional part of the FUN001 correction.
findings.impact: The established regression command fails and cannot serve as passing release evidence. These diffs do not show a wrong phrase, wallet match, count or encoded byte.
findings.recommendedFix: Keep the complete-date recovery correction. Update these exact expected objects from literal public dates, deliberately decide the optional evidence shape, and retain phrase/count/progress assertions. Add the mixed known/guessed case rather than changing to permissive partial matching.
findings.requiredVerification: Run this one file sequentially and require all 19 cases pass; keep the bounded FUN001 exact recovered-phrase regressions passing. Do not remove allDates or relax checks merely to get green.

remediation.title: Invalid formatted-create encoding drops unvisited shares unwiped; current WASM retains a public quorum

evidence.sourceAssessment: The invalid-encoding path returns before share generation. Every successfully generated raw share is wrapped before record formatting, and encode_share now accepts a validated enum without a Result refusal path.

remediation.remainingGap: No remaining source cause identified for this original invalid-encoding/unvisited-share defect. Artifact memory behavior has not been executed in this review; canonical seven-pin match is supplied coordinator/user evidence, not newly checked here.
requiredVerification: Coordinator, later authorized: run one isolated fresh-instance unsupported-code case against existing hash-bound canonical bytes, compare pre-call/control counts, require zero occurrences of ALL fixture payloads after refusal, retain counts/digests only.
Run a tiny supported Compact UR/Bytewords fixture control separately. No rebuild, full vector replay or memory dump is required.
regressionConcerns: Preserve successful Compact UR and Bytewords outputs and copied input/seed cleanup on ordinary error returns. Rust panic/abort and all dependency/CBOR/string allocations are outside this narrow closure claim.
The retained historical baseline harness asserts that residual shares DO exist at lines 57-60; it is baseline evidence and cannot be reused unchanged as a passing fix acceptance test.
remediation.verificationStatus: bounded-runtime-evidence; full stated acceptance not completed

remediation.title: Combined code/date recovery returns guessed dates but drops the known dates used to find the wallet

evidence.sourceAssessment: DateCandidate and DateMatch carry allDates alongside guessed-only dates. Combined recovery returns allDates for decoding, retains guessed text for display, and refuses a result whose mnemonic is absent from decoding with allDates. CLI decodes with outcome.dates.

remediation.remainingGap: No runtime confirmation. The added mixed-date regression does not cover legacy-valid mode or CLI interaction.
remediation.requiredVerification: Coordinator later runs only bounded mixed known/guessed regressions in all three masked modes, compares exact phrase/fingerprint, checks guessed-only display, and traces final CLI decode to the same wallet.
remediation.regressionConcerns: Known dates are copied/frozen; guessed result dates are newly allocated but their objects are not deeply frozen. Legacy-valid mode can legitimately return several original phrases; the membership check does not prove a later host selects the matched one.
remediation.verificationStatus: bounded-runtime-evidence; full stated acceptance not completed

remediation.title: Complete-date code-search plan assumes one wallet call when legacy-valid mode gives128

evidence.sourceAssessment: WalletWay.plan includes measured decoding time and Masking.checksPerDecoding(wordCount) times calibrated wallet-check cost. Direct gives one check; masked variants delegate to existing mode-owned checksPerCombination. Explicit limit precedence remains in asksFirst.

remediation.remainingGap: No execution. Added plan test covers 12-word legacy-valid only, with zero simulated decoding cost.
remediation.requiredVerification: With fake clock/callbacks compare bounded unmatched actual callback counts and plan costs across modes and 12/24 words; include nonzero decoding cost, crossing 12 hours, and explicit limit precedence.
remediation.regressionConcerns: Legacy non-valid estimates average checksum survival; matching early reduces actual callbacks. One-candidate decoding timing remains an estimate, and calibration still invokes three real host checks.
remediation.verificationStatus: bounded-runtime-evidence; full stated acceptance not completed

remediation.title: Direct Bytewords conversion double-tags accepted current/legacy tagged UR input

evidence.sourceAssessment: Direct tagged UR conversion now removes the accepted tag and writes exactly one current tag; the shared helper is used after checksum and layout validation.
evidence.coordinatorReconciliation: Current helper extraction reread; both producers delegate to untaggedCbor. Current and legacy tag regression passes on stable final source.

remediation.remainingGap: No remaining source double-tag cause identified; direct converter/writeShare runtime and independent expected bytes have not been verified.
requiredVerification: Later run only the small FUN003 case, plus direct writeShare(taggedUr, words) cases and Share.read(...).write(words) controls.
Compare full tagged bytes/CRC with an independently fixed literal, and ensure unknown-tag/bad-CRC inputs refuse.
regressionConcerns: Retain current/legacy/untagged input compatibility, both permitted short headers, and rejection of bad tag/CRC. Borrowed subarray slicing must not mutate caller bytes.
remediation.verificationStatus: bounded-runtime-evidence; full stated acceptance not completed

remediation.title: New exported mixed-radix iterator never terminates for an empty radix

evidence.sourceAssessment: Exported placeCombinations now takes a dense owned copy of each radix, refuses absent/empty places and invalid word indexes, and delegates to a private unchecked counter. The finite counter and borrowed yielded-array contract are preserved.

remediation.remainingGap: No execution. Outer sparse/getter and mutation-after-construction cases are absent from inspected regression.
remediation.requiredVerification: Bounded first/last empty, outer/inner sparse, invalid scalar and changing-getter refusals; finite count/order for small valid products and input mutation isolation. Copy each yielded array.
remediation.regressionConcerns: An empty outer list yields one empty product then ends; yielded output remains borrowed and must be copied. Existing internal searches deliberately use the guarded private kernel.
remediation.verificationStatus: bounded-runtime-evidence; full stated acceptance not completed

remediation.title: Direct joint-repair APIs parse records before enforcing the shared count boundary

evidence.sourceAssessment: Both directly callable entries now reach the common count refusal before any record is read.

remediation.remainingGap: No remaining source order gap; class-entry and boundary runtime assertions have not been run.
requiredVerification: Later tiny function AND JointRepair.plan empty/length-257 proxy cases: require intended 1..256 error, zero indexed accesses and zero engine calls.
Use one permitted length-1 public input as a control that parsing is reached; no full 256/257 assessment.
regressionConcerns: Keep independently callable outer guards; pre-aborted signals may legitimately reject before count validation. Do not actually process 257 records to prove refusal.
remediation.verificationStatus: bounded-runtime-evidence; full stated acceptance not completed

remediation.title: The bundled-assets test fails after the font request moved behind UI_FONT

evidence.sourceAssessment: The original literal-font discovery regression is source-fixed. The identifier-request regex captures UI_FONT from readRenderAsset(UI_FONT), then resolves the quoted const UI_FONT initializer in that same source file. It does not scan renderAssets values as requests. The bounded git diff only adds constant-backed discovery; existing literal discovery and catalogue checks are unchanged.

remediation.remainingGap: None identified for the original literal-font root cause. This reviewer ran no tests; the coordinator reports a passing focused 9-test run and owns its retained command/log/snapshot evidence.
remediation.requiredVerification: Original font discovery and the focused renderer-platform regression are satisfied according to the coordinator report. Bind the coordinator result to its retained command/log and source hashes; do not require unrelated gate redesign to close this finding.
remediation.regressionConcerns: No weakened gate demonstrated. Pre-existing one-way inventory coverage and general regex/AST limitations are separate informational coverage observations, not reasons to keep BLD001 open.
remediation.verificationStatus: bounded-runtime-evidence; full stated acceptance not completed

remediation.title: Candidate exports leave caller-owned temporary entropy arrays unwiped

evidence.sourceAssessment: savePhraseCandidates incrementally owns entropy arrays under try/finally; both date and SSKR callers delegate, while saveCandidates borrows inputs.

remediation.remainingGap: No direct wrapper buffer-reference regression located; immutable strings and dependency-internal failed allocations remain outside this fix.
remediation.requiredVerification: Tiny synthetic nonzero arrays retained by conversion stubs must be zero after success/failure/skip and a second conversion throw; borrowed saveCandidates inputs survive. Cover both callers without full recovery.
remediation.regressionConcerns: Preserve borrowed input, saved bytes/order and cleanup after partial conversion, preparation/protection/write error or skip/cancel.

remediation.title: Owned candidate-list temporary secret buffers are discarded without wiping

evidence.sourceAssessment: Encode registers copied passphrase arrays before later record validation and wipes registered arrays in finally. Decode registers each copied entropy before reading its passphrase and wipes accumulated entropies on UTF-8/CRC/padding/truncation failure. However assertListPassphrase still allocates encoder.encode(passphrase) solely for length and discards that secret array without wiping. Coordinator captured four encoder temporary arrays: two wiped serialization copies and two unwiped validation copies. The CRC-refused decoder copy is wiped; borrowed entropy survives.

remediation.remainingGap: The length-validation buffer is never registered in owned, including when an oversized passphrase throws. No captured-buffer zeroization regression in inspected tests.
remediation.requiredVerification: First remove/wipe the length-validation allocation. Later capture TextEncoder arrays on success, oversized/later-record refusal, and copied decode entropy on UTF-8/CRC/padding/truncation failure; assert zeroization only for owned abandoned buffers and unchanged borrowed/returned buffers.
remediation.regressionConcerns: Challenge: the array at line 85 is a distinct TextEncoder allocation from line 93; finally covers only the latter. This is residual original temporary-buffer ownership, not a new finding. Borrowed input entropy, successful decoded records and returned encoded bytes must survive. Cleanup of partially written output if serialization itself throws is not established.
remediation.verificationStatus: bounded-runtime-evidence; full stated acceptance not completed

remediation.title: Joint assessment abandons temporary secret-bearing arrays without best-effort cleanup

evidence.sourceAssessment: Evaluator/interpolation cleanup and ordinary refused-original-space cleanup improve the original finding. Remaining ended-owner gaps are the pre-try allocation stage; discarded refinement/branch state; and deltaOf(original) consumed only by bytesToBits.

remediation.remainingGap: Move the initial reading loop inside cleanup scope and track derived/expanded branch ownership. Clean only buffers not retained by the returned search plan, including replaced/refused branch secretAndDigest and visibleDeltas, discarded expanded spaces, and consumed delta temporaries. sd0 also needs an exceptional-exit cleanup scope if later operations can throw.
requiredVerification: Later tiny synthetic reference/alias probes: residual evaluation and interpolation copies are zero after their job, including first delta consumed by bytesToBits.

Abort between first and second reading; inspect previously owned arrays. Exercise a failed/non-improving refinement, a successful replacement, and a too-open/refused plan; require dead buffers zero and retained aliases unchanged.
Search the same live plan twice, then cancel one invocation and retry with a fresh signal; results must remain intact. Do not perform large search workloads.
regressionConcerns: Do not wipe live reusable branches after successful search or cancellation of one invocation. Selected branches may share ReadingSpace arrays: cleanup must deduplicate ownership and preserve retained aliases.

Current space cleanup is verdict-based; on successful refinement it skips all original spaces even though selected branches reference newly constructed expanded spaces. JS heap residual extraction and actual lifetime/compromise remain unmeasured.

remediation.title: Card-specific validation does not bind label groups to rendered color slots

evidence.sourceAssessment: The card owner first rejects phrase labels, copies share labels with Array.from (exposing sparse entries), and requires a nonblank string group for each color. Business, glass and material invoke it before document/font/asset creation. Generic assertShareQr still allows labels-only identity validation.

remediation.remainingGap: No original mismatch regression was found in the scoped test sources; source does not establish output correctness. ColorCardContent remains a union-valued interface, but the runtime phrase-label refusal enforces the separation.
remediation.requiredVerification: Future pure guard tests: fewer/more/zero/sparse/empty labels refused, phrase labels refused, valid one-per-color labels accepted, wrong-share payload refused, generic labels-only transport accepted. Stub assets to prove all three direct family boundaries refuse before reads.
remediation.regressionConcerns: Preserve labels-only transport use and exact grouped share identity; do not couple decorative colors to share bytes.

remediation.title: A post-rename chmod failure publishes a private folder while reporting save failure

evidence.sourceAssessment: chmod(staging,0700) now precedes the final absence recheck and rename. Rename is the final awaited operation on success, so the old post-publication chmod rejection is removed. All three exporters delegate to this owner.

remediation.remainingGap: No folder-publication fault matrix found in retained scoped test sources. Filesystem permissions, cleanup failure and rename behavior were not executed.
remediation.requiredVerification: Future no-render synthetic-marker fault matrix for writer/chmod/recheck/rename failure: target absent and staging cleaned on each pre-publication failure; success returns writer result, final folder0700/file0600; preserve existing target. Confirm all three caller delegations.
remediation.regressionConcerns: Keep owner-only modes and never delete the published target as rollback. The pre-existing absentPath/rename race is outside the original finding; no new race claim.

remediation.title: Business/glass fragments bypass shared orientation validation

evidence.sourceAssessment: pageDimensions now parses both size and orientation, reaching business resize and glass layout. Material invokes it too, but materialPageLayout null-coalesces orientation to landscape before parsing; runtime null therefore remains accepted instead of being refused. Coordinator pure geometry probe confirms material null becomes the default while shared pageDimensions refuses null.

remediation.remainingGap: Material runtime-null acceptance prevents full original nonstring acceptance. Business/glass orientation refusal occurs after font/document work; current source does not prove early refusal or family parity.
remediation.requiredVerification: Future pure geometry tests and direct/wrapper boundary stubs for omitted, portrait, landscape, invalid string, null and number; require orientation diagnostics, preserve defaults and card fragment geometry. No rasterization needed.
remediation.regressionConcerns: Defaults and geometry must stay family-specific; null must not silently become an omitted option. No rendering was used to assess this path.
remediation.verificationStatus: bounded-runtime-evidence; full stated acceptance not completed

remediation.title: ShareCardSet silently uses colors for an unsupported shareFormat

evidence.sourceAssessment: ShareCardSet checks requested.shareFormat against transport-owned Share.FORMATS before layout resolution, identity randomness and share validation. Omission defaults to colors; ur still adapts to words via LABELLED_FORMS.

remediation.remainingGap: No retained constructor-negative test for unknown/null/number/empty shareFormat found. Six-format acceptance and exact payload expectations have not been executed.
remediation.requiredVerification: Future constructor-only all-six/default tests with literal printedCodes/payload expectations; typo/null/number/empty rejected before random callback or share processing.
remediation.regressionConcerns: Keep validation before random choice and share parsing; retain UR-to-Bytewords behavior and colors-unicode dispatch.

remediation.title: Containment treats a POSIX literal backslash as a directory separator

evidence.sourceAssessment: pathWithin splits relative paths only on active node:path.sep; cloud/output/menu consumers still delegate.

remediation.remainingGap: Literal POSIX backslash and Windows regressions not located/executed.
remediation.requiredVerification: Accept POSIX literal ..\notes child, preserve its cloud warning/output overlap checks, refuse real ../ and siblings; separately cover Windows separators and drives.
remediation.regressionConcerns: Keep equality, ..notes, parent/sibling and cross-drive refusal; this is lexical containment, not a symlink guarantee.

remediation.title: Public raw pattern counting/enumeration/recovery omits relational key validation

evidence.sourceAssessment: ownedPatterns copies, validates calendar domains, and rejects conflicting equal keys via the shared conflictingPatternKey owner. Raw combination counting, enumeration, and recovery invoke it; DatesAnswer retains contextual same-owner enforcement.

remediation.remainingGap: No dedicated raw same-key conflict/equivalent-domain regression in the inspected test sources; no execution.
remediation.requiredVerification: At raw count/enumeration/recovery and DatesAnswer boundaries: refuse same-key different domains; accept same-key reordered/duplicate equivalent domains and distinct keys; compare bounded count with enumeration length.
remediation.regressionConcerns: Normalization sorts/deduplicates domains before comparison. Equivalent same-key permutations must remain accepted; distinct keys may intentionally denote overlapping domains.

remediation.title: Listed recovery state retains mutable caller-owned date objects

evidence.sourceAssessment: ListWay and WalletWay snapshot the complete date list through ownedDates, using Array.from(ownedDate) and freezing both dates and list before any asynchronous work.

remediation.remainingGap: No listed-date mutation-across-await regression in inspected sources; no execution.
remediation.requiredVerification: Use a few public candidates and a controlled pending fingerprint callback; mutate caller array/date after construction and during await; rows must equal an immutable control. Refuse sparse/calendar-invalid dates.
remediation.regressionConcerns: Borrowed caller objects must remain unchanged. Copies are taken once before the fingerprint callback; sparse/invalid dates should refuse at construction.

remediation.title: Shared BIP39 word-count metadata remains mutable through public JS export

evidence.sourceAssessment: The public BIP39_WORD_COUNTS tuple is now Object.freeze at definition. Entropy lengths and wordCountOfEntropy derive from that tuple.

remediation.remainingGap: No Object.isFrozen/mutation-refusal regression for the tuple in inspected tests; no execution.
remediation.requiredVerification: Assert runtime freezing; bounded push/pop/slot-write attempts cannot alter tuple; all five entropy/word-count mappings and downstream size consumers stay unchanged.
remediation.regressionConcerns: Derived metadata and captured sets must continue agreeing after a JavaScript host attempts mutation; readonly typing alone is not the acceptance criterion.

remediation.title: Sparse profile arrays evade all-profile Bitcoin evidence validation
